title: start-pair-live.sh: pin governed runtime defaults — PAIR_SEMANTIC_MODE=guarded + PAIR_OBJECTIVE_AUTO_DRIVER=1 (env-overridable)
description: Operator-launcher posture defaults on base 9bbaac1. The verified live stack (guarded semantic gating + P15.10-C governed objective auto-driver) previously depended on undocumented operator env — a fresh clone running scripts/start-pair-live.sh booted semantic=off / driver absent and silently lost the verified behaviour. The launcher now exports both flags in the serve-mission-control env block using ${VAR:-default} form: PAIR_SEMANTIC_MODE=guarded, PAIR_OBJECTIVE_AUTO_DRIVER=1. Both remain env-overridable — a caller exporting a different value wins; nothing is hard-pinned. Governance posture is unchanged: the driver existing ≠ autonomous work enabled — each objective still requires the owner's own auto_policy configure+enable with finite caps and expiry before any autonomous pass can be admitted; the driver continues to fail closed without it. Guarded remains the most fail-closed semantic mode (advisory analysis pinned; MATERIAL ambiguity blocks until owner resolution; AUTHORITY_CRITICAL always blocks). No secrets, tokens, or machine-local paths are added. Proof: src/__tests__/pair-live-stack-flags.test.ts asserts both ${VAR:-default} exports exist inside the serve env block and appear exactly once in the script.
